description: A four-way clock divider fed by a Klok placed immediately to its left

params.text: Sets how many Klok pulses pass between pulses at its own output, a whole number from 1 to 256

outputs.text: Carries a 10ms pulse at 10V each time Klok's pulse count divides by its own division factor

notes: this module goes immediately to the right of a Klok; with no Klok there all four outputs stay at 0V
the outputs are silent while Klok's run switch is off
Klok's pulse count wraps every 256 pulses, so a factor that does not divide 256 gives one short gap at the wrap
a slip in Klok's source means every factor above 1 also produces one extra pulse at count 1 of each 256-pulse cycle
